title: W3C Web Cryptography Working Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Web Cryptography Working Group

items.content_html:
Important

This issue will be worked on by MDN's core team of writers. If you want to contribute, please see the contributor board for issues where we're accepting pull requests.

Acceptance criteria

  • The listed features are documented sufficiently on MDN
  • BCD is updated
  • Interactive example and data repos are updated if appropriate
  • The content has been reviewed as needed

For folks helping with Firefox related documentation

Note

Release notes are now generated at the beginning of the cycle, so a review is all that should be needed for the task. Obviously if there is a gap, fill it.

  • Set bugs to dev-doc-complete
  • Review/add entry to Firefox release notes for enabled/preview features
  • Add/remove entry to Firefox experimental features page for preference/released features

Features to document

The Exceptions section https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SubtleCrypto/deriveBits#exceptions documents OperationError for a bad length and no TypeError. Out-of-range values now throw synchronously instead of rejecting, so the exceptions list needs updating.

Related Gecko bugs

  • Bug 2065212 — Make the length parameter of crypto.subtle.deriveBits [EnforceRange]

Other

  • Check content open issues to see if any pertain to the subject matter. If there are any that can be closed because of the work, do so. If there are any that can be fixed relatively quickly because of the knowledge from completing this issue and you have time, feel free to go ahead and fix them.
items.title: [WebCryptoAPI] [WebAPI] Make the length parameter of crypto.subtle.deriveBits [EnforceRange]

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SubtleCrypto/encrypt

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Supported Algorithm

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

This page is missing information about the algorithm we can use. For example, for the RSA-OAEP there is a limit in the number of bytes you can encrypt. I did not check for the others algorithm but theses limitation are missing in the doc. Just a warning that says "The algorithm can have some limitation such as the size of the data to encode. Check the RFC for more information" would be really helpfull since the error message are basically inexistent at this point in time.

What did you expect to see?

An array with what an algorithm can encode and the limitation

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
